description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Andrew Wommack Ministries, Inc. is hiring a Full Stack WordPress Developer to design, develop, and maintain secure, reliable, user-friendly websites and applications across its digital ecosystem. The role focuses on WordPress sites and React frontends for headless WordPress, including performance, scalability, and security improvements.
Full Stack WordPress Developer building and maintaining WordPress sites and React headless frontends, optimizing performance and security

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, evaluate, enhance, test, and maintain WordPress sites using MySQL databases, and WordPress plugins/themes on a cloud-hosted LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) stack
• Build and maintain React-based frontends for headless WordPress sites, integrating REST or GraphQL APIs, CDNs, etc., as required
• Optimize standardization, performance, scalability, and security across sites
• Perform other related tasks as needed

Requirements:
• The ideal candidate will be proficient in PHP, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React, with a proven ability to deliver visually appealing, secure, performant, and mobile-responsive interfaces
• This position requires the applicant to be a self-starter who is self-directed, personable, an excellent communicator, and can work independently and as a member of a team
• Must have strong critical thinking skills with an analytical mind
• Strong attention to detail
• Strong verbal and written communication skills
• Excellent problem-solving skills
• Ability to work with a team, while also being a self-starter with the ability to self-direct
• Working knowledge (or demonstrated aptitude to learn) in the following areas:
• WordPress CMS, CRM, DB, SEO, APIs, Security, and design plugins
• HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, along with web development standards, best practices, including Mobile First, Responsiveness, Scalability, Performance, etc
• Page and site optimization techniques for media content, analytics, and site flows
• Must have a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
• Must sign the Statement of Faith
• A high school diploma or equivalent education is required
• 1-3 years of professional experience in website development, management, design, and/or support across a variety of stacks
• Demonstrated experience coding in React, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, and database languages like SQL

Preferred:
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or equivalent preferred
• A Charis Bible College graduate is preferred
• Proficiency working with WordPress plugins (e.g., WooCommerce, Wordfence, Jetpack, WP Super Cache, Elementor Pro, etc.), preferred experience and ability to develop custom plugins and themes
